# What You Can Do Now

<!-- STEP id="civic-responsibility" -->
## You Are Already a Citizen

You cannot vote until you are 18, but you can already practise **civic responsibility**: respecting others' rights, using social media responsibly, abiding by laws and rules, appreciating the country's diversity, and taking part in activities that strengthen unity.

Being well-informed is also a vital responsibility of a young citizen.

<!-- STEP id="five-paths" -->
## Five Ways to Take Part

Young people can take part in five ways: understand the Constitution, follow fundamental duties, take leadership in school and community, be media literate, and join nation-building activities. Press Next path for an example of each.

NSS and NCC teach this through community service and teamwork.

**You can start today, before you are 18.**
